about_the_game:
A survival horror game where a terrible accident traps you in a twisted circus within your dying mind. Move swiftly and stay hidden to avoid the deadly clown lurking in your thoughts. Uncover the secrets of your subconscious... and wake up before it's too late.

ESCAPE THE NIGHTMARE

Trapped inside your own thoughts where innocence turns into dread, you must find your way out before the fear consumes you. A place once filled with laughter now echoes with something far more sinister.

 

 

 

BEWARE OF THE CLOWN

Something is stalking you. An evil entity prowls the circus, drawn to the slightest sound or sudden movement. As you sneak through crumbling tents and playground ruins, the tension never lets up. You’ll need to rely on hiding spots and careful timing to stay alive.

 

 

 

COLLECT THE POSTERS

To escape this nightmare, you must uncover and collect the scattered circus posters hidden throughout the world. Each poster is a fragment of forgotten memories—and gathering them all is your only chance to survive.

 

 

 

KEY FEATURES

  • Non-linear exploration in a nightmarish circus.

  • Multiple endings defined by your performance.

  • Ever-present monstrous clown that reacts to your actions.

  • Tense stealth gameplay focused on sneaking, hiding, and escaping.
